about.headline: A Sweet Story Born in Tabuk
paragraphs: Shahad Sweet began as a small dream in Tabuk -- a dream to offer our community sweets that blend the authenticity of Arabic flavors with the artistry of international confections. From a single branch, we grew together until we became an inseparable part of every celebration in Tabuk.
We select our ingredients with utmost care, and every piece is crafted by skilled artisans who believe that sweets are not just food -- they are a language of joy we speak to every home in Tabuk.
Today, with over seven branches across Tabuk, we continue our commitment to the quality and taste you have known us for since day one.
